verdict.rationale: Modal ships an official CLI with a first-party reference page (modal.com/docs/reference/cli). It documents running a command or interactive shell inside a Modal container and managing or connecting to running containers, which covers the core of using an official CLI. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of sandbox-specific CLI subcommands, documentation of agent-friendly CLI features (e.g. machine-readable output), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
